metadata.title: यह चीन का नहीं, हमारे देश का खाना है | Not Chinese — This Is Purely Indian Food!
metadata.description:
In this episode of Tribal Kitchen, we explore one of the most unique culinary pairings from Bodoland in Assam. The Bodo community takes pride in their traditional rice-based wine, Joe Gran, a drink brewed with care and passed down through generations. To accompany this special brew, the Bodo people prepare a delicacy that may surprise many – crispy, flavorful silkworms, cooked with local spices that bring out their rich, earthy taste. Together, Joe Gran and silkworms form a combination that is not just food and drink, but a reflection of the Bodo identity, their deep connection with the land, and their celebration of community life. This episode offers viewers a rare chance to savour the culture, flavours, and traditions that make Bodo cuisine truly extraordinary.
#food #northeastindia
